body.title: Fix the flaky checkout e2e test

body.text: The checkout e2e test fails about one CI run in five. Find out why.

body.output:
30 passed (1.1m)
  chromium: 10 passed
  firefox: 10 passed
  webkit: skipped, no browser on linux-arm64

body.text:
Chromium and Firefox pass 10 out of 10; every CI failure is WebKit. The test clicks **Pay** before the card field reports ready, and only WebKit loads the payment iframe late enough to lose that race.

This box has no WebKit build, so I can't confirm a fix here. Hand the session to a Mac and I'll carry on there.

Staging is throwing 500s since the last deploy, roll it back.

body.summary: Run kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n staging --to-revision=41

body.text: Audit how the webhook handlers retry failed deliveries and fix anything unsafe.
Three separate questions here, so I'll fan out: one agent maps every handler, one reviews the retry backoff, one checks the idempotency keys. Meanwhile I'll read the queue config.

input.prompt: List every webhook handler under src/webhooks. For each, say when it acknowledges the delivery, when it persists the event, and what it does on failure.
Read src/jobs/retry.rs and the worker that uses it. Is the backoff capped, jittered and bounded in attempts? Propose a fix if not.
Find where webhook events are deduplicated. Which providers' events can be processed twice if a retry races the first attempt?

body.output:
src/webhooks/stripe.rs:41
src/webhooks/github.rs:28
src/webhooks/paypal.rs:35
src/webhooks/shopify.rs:52
src/webhooks/slack.rs:19
src/webhooks/twilio.rs:23
src/webhooks/zendesk.rs:31

pr.title: Cap webhook retries and persist before acking

body.text: Seven handlers. Five persist the event before they answer 200; stripe.rs and github.rs answer first and persist in a spawned task.

body.output:
Seven handlers in src/webhooks.

- **paypal, shopify, slack, twilio, zendesk** persist the event, then answer 200. Safe.
- **stripe.rs:41** and **github.rs:28** answer 200 first and persist in a spawned task. If the process dies in between, the event is lost and the sender never retries.

Fix: move `store.insert(event)` above the response in both, as the other five do.

body.text: The delay doubles with no cap and no jitter, and `max_attempts = 0` in config/queue.toml means unlimited. After 20 attempts a job waits 12 days. Checking how the worker reads the setting.
Deduplication keys on (provider, event_id), but only Stripe sends a stable event id. Checking what the others send.

The handler map is back: **stripe** and **github** acknowledge before they persist, so a crash in between loses the event. `max_attempts = 0` also means unlimited retries. I'll wait for the backoff and idempotency reviews before I change anything.
Upgrade date-fns to v4 and fix whatever breaks.
date-fns 4 drops `utcToZonedTime`; time zones now go through `@date-fns/tz`. I've moved `formatOrderDate` over. Running the web tests to see what else breaks.
Roll out the 30-day log retention policy: Terraform, the Loki Helm values and the runbook.

Three pieces that don't touch each other: the bucket lifecycle in Terraform, Loki's retention in the Helm values, and the restore runbook. I'll give each to a child on its own branch, then review the three diffs together.
